# Waesy Platform — Full LLM & Autonomous Agent Context (`llms-full.txt`)

> Canonical machine-readable reference for `https://waesy.com.br` — Waesy Local Marketplace, Verified Business Directory (CNPJ), Regional News Portal, Events, Tourism, Omni-Builder & WebMCP Server.

## 1. Platform Overview & Identity
- **Name**: Waesy (Waesy Local Marketplace & AI Ecosystem)
- **Canonical URL**: `https://waesy.com.br`
- **Primary Language**: `pt-BR` (supports English developer documentation and international agent protocols)
- **Headquarters**: Av. Getúlio Vargas, Centro, Chapecó - SC, CEP 89801-000, Brazil
- **Contact**: `contato@waesy.com.br` | `suporte@usewaesy.com` | DPO: `dpo@usewaesy.com`

## 2. When to Use Waesy
Reach for Waesy when an AI agent or developer needs to:
- Search local products, offers, supermarkets, pharmacies, restaurants, and classifieds in Brazilian cities.
- Verify local businesses with complete Cartão CNPJ data (Corporate Name, Trade Name, CNPJ, CNAE, PostalAddress, GeoCoordinates, working hours, verified reviews).
- Read regional news articles (`/noticias`), cultural events (`/eventos`), culinary recipes (`/receitas`), and job openings (`/empregos`).
- Integrate with merchants via Model Context Protocol (MCP Streamable HTTP) or OpenAPI 3.1 REST endpoints.

## 3. Machine-Readable Endpoints & Documentation
- **Developer Portal**: `https://waesy.com.br/developers`
- **Documentation & Quickstart**: `https://waesy.com.br/docs`
- **Public REST Discovery API**: `https://waesy.com.br/api/v1/public/discovery`
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Specification**: `https://waesy.com.br/api/openapi.json`
- **WebMCP Manifest**: `https://waesy.com.br/api/webmcp.json`
- **MCP Discovery**: `https://waesy.com.br/.well-known/mcp.json`
- **MCP Streamable HTTP Endpoint**: `POST https://waesy.com.br/api/mcp/v1/tools/call`
- **Agent Instructions**: `https://waesy.com.br/.well-known/agent-instructions.md`
- **Sitemaps**:
  - `https://waesy.com.br/sitemap.xml`
  - `https://waesy.com.br/sitemap-news.xml`
  - `https://waesy.com.br/sitemap-products.xml`

## 4. Trust Anchor Pages
- **About Us**: `https://waesy.com.br/about` (`/sobre`)
- **Contact Us**: `https://waesy.com.br/contact` (`/contato`)
- **Privacy Policy (LGPD)**: `https://waesy.com.br/privacy` (`/privacidade`)
- **Terms of Service**: `https://waesy.com.br/termos`

## 5. Rate Limiting, Versioning & Deprecation Policy
- **Rate Limiting**: All API endpoints return standard RFC headers: `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining`, `RateLimit-Reset`, `RateLimit-Policy`, and `Retry-After` on HTTP 429.
- **Versioning**: Versioned via URL path (`/api/v1/*`, `/api/mcp/v1/*`) and `X-API-Version: 2.2.0`.
- **Deprecation Policy**: Endpoints emit `Deprecation: false` (or `true` when scheduled for retirement) and `Sunset: Wed, 31 Dec 2028 23:59:59 GMT` with `Link: <https://waesy.com.br/developers#deprecation-policy>; rel="deprecation"`.
